# Stage full agent brief

Stage is an open source browser face puppet studio (formerly referred to in some repos as WebPuppet). Visitors can grant camera and optional microphone access, or start a sample performance with no camera. MediaPipe Face Landmarker runs in a WebWorker from self hosted assets. Behaviors map face and audio signals onto tagged 2D puppet layers rendered in Pixi.js.

Canonical production URL: https://webpuppet.vercel.app/
Source: https://github.com/vinita-byte/WebPuppet

Privacy: camera and mic data never leave the device.

## Product surface

### Studio UI (`/`)
- Brand: Stage (logo mark, favicon, light and dark themes)
- Menu bar: File, Edit, View, Puppet, Record, Help (keyboard accessible)
- Left tool strip: camera, sample face, calibrate, record
- Hero stage with fit framing, safe area, full screen, floating camera preview
- Teleprompter overlay with editable script, scroll speed, font size, mirror mode
- Right inspector tabs: Puppet, Behaviors, Frame
- Bottom status strip: camera, tracking quality, FPS, puppet, scene, frame, saved
- Scrollable page with visible SEO content below the studio
- Built in guided demo tour on first visit; replay from Help, Demo video
- Character picker (new cast plus studio classics)
- Twelve scene backgrounds with animated props
- Stage frame modes: 16:9, 9:16, fill
- Capture: Start camera, Try without a camera, Calibrate
- Clear messages for camera denied, no camera, and tracking lost
- Tracking quality: Good, Slow, Off
- Behaviors toggles with reset defaults
- SVG character idea prompts under Help
- Pixi viewport
- Timeline with time ruler, keyframe markers, 3 2 1 countdown, play, loop, clear with confirm and undo
- Export dialog for MP4 or MOV
- Character package export/import (webpuppet.zip with puppet.json; prefer SVG layer assets, PNG supported)
- Record video take of the Pixi stage (+ mic when available); download MOV or MP4 via on device ffmpeg.wasm
- Video takes are memory only and cleared on Clear, tab close, or session dispose
- Autosave of settings and last keyframe recording to IndexedDB (video is never persisted)

### Agent discovery files
- `/llms.txt`
- `/llms-full.txt`
- `/sitemap.xml`
- `/robots.txt`
- `/.well-known/ai-catalog.json`

## Architecture map

```
src/
  puppets/             Character definitions, layer tags, swap sets, triggers, physics, zip export
  services/vision/     MediaPipe worker (self hosted), demo tracker, landmark buffers
  services/audio/      Mic analyser and viseme calculator
  services/behaviors/  Modular puppet drivers
  components/viewport/ Pixi canvas and PuppetRig
  components/timeline/ Keyframe record and playback
  components/studio/   Menu bar, tool strip, inspector, demo tour, shell
  store/               Zustand stores (app, puppet, scene, recording, video, layout)
  lib/persistence.ts   IndexedDB autosave
public/mediapipe/      Self hosted WASM and face_landmarker.task
```

## Local development

```bash
npm install
npm run dev
```

Open http://localhost:3000. Use Start Tracking or Try without a camera.
